title: dubbii is a lifesaver!
body: Higly recommeded! Everyday adulting that ADHDers struggle with become easier with clear, step-by-step videos. My home was a total mess; there were piles of stuff and clutter everywhere. The videos and live body doubling sessions have helped me declutter room after room. It's incredible that now, at the age of sixty, I've learned how to clean the kitchen and bathroom in a sensible and efficient way, without getting lost in side projects, thanks to the videos. I'm amazed at what I can do when I finally get the right kind of practical help!
author: Sarika66

title: Amazing!
body: I’ve been seeing the ads for this app for a long time. I always tought that it’s cool but wouldn’t help me. Well then I saw one ad where they said that they have prerecorded step by step videos. I was sold and decided to try the app. I instantly fell in love. I never thought I could clean by myself. But this app made it possible! The only things I would wish for are more prerecorded body double videos and a dark mode for the app. Absolutely love it and would/will recommend it to everyone!
author: I cleaned!!!
